title: Finch Circle Loyalty Program — Late Credit of Points for a Purchase Made Without the Member Number
content:
## When this applies

A member of the Finch Circle Loyalty Program whose Finch Circle number was not captured at checkout files the missing-points request for one purchase record. For a missing-points request this policy handles, and only for such a request, the purchase whose points are asked for is the member's most recent purchase record, by purchase date, on which no Finch Circle number was captured and which is kept, that is, in completed status, and the request names that purchase record; a request for any other purchase is not one this policy handles and stays under the standing missing-points request rule. The claimed unit is that purchase record.

The result is one missing-points credit entry on the membership's points history for the claimed unit, credited at once, with the membership's points balance rising by the points credited.

## When the credit is fixed

The missing-points credit is fixed only after the membership record shows at least the Finch Circle tier that an active Marlowe & Finch card status floor grants the member.

Put the other way: while the membership record shows a tier below the one that the member's active Marlowe & Finch card status floor grants, the missing-points credit is not yet fixed.

## Filing the claim: `file_missing_points_claim_8cff3bd6`

**Capability.** The member files, in person, a Finch Circle missing-points claim for one purchase record of theirs on which no member number was captured at checkout, and the claim is credited at once. The member's request is recorded as a completed missing-points request naming that purchase record, one missing-points credit entry carrying the given points and qualifying amount is posted to the membership's points history, and the membership's points balance rises by the given points. The member sees the credit in the points history and the higher balance immediately.

**How it is invoked.** This is the member's own tool. Customer care unlocks `file_missing_points_claim_8cff3bd6` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it with the values below.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `membership_id` | the reference number of the member's Finch Circle membership, as returned by the membership lookup | identifier |
| `purchase_id` | the reference number of the purchase record (one unit of one item) being claimed, as returned by the purchase lookup | identifier |
| `qualifying_amount` | the net qualifying dollars of the claimed unit on which the credit is figured | USD, 2 decimal places, stored rounded half up to the cent |
| `points` | the points credited for the claimed unit | a positive whole number of points, no decimal part |

**Return.** A receipt with: `status` ("credited" when the claim was recorded and the points posted); `request_id` (reference number of the completed missing-points request); `entry_id` (reference number of the missing-points credit entry); `purchase_id` (the purchase record credited); `points` (whole points credited); `qualifying_amount` (USD, 2 decimal places); `points_balance` (the membership's new points balance, whole points).

## Points of judgement

- **Which purchase does the claim cover?** The member's most recent purchase record, by purchase date, without a captured Finch Circle number and in completed status. A request for an older purchase falls under the standing missing-points request rule.
- **Who runs the claim?** The member, after customer care unlocks it and hands it over.
